note: The OLG covers most FNS 726 simplified reporting requirements well. It explains the certification type (Simplified Reporting Overview), periodic report/IR requirements for households certified >6 months (Simplified Reporting – Interim Report), the elderly/disabled exemption from the gross income limit (Simplified Reporting – Examples Q3/Q4; Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance), the ABAWD work hours reporting requirement when hours fall below 20/week (Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance – 'Subject to ABAWD Work Rules and Work Hours Fall Below 20 Per Week'), and the 10-day reporting deadline after end of month (Simplified Reporting Overview: 'no later than the 10th day following the end of the calendar month'). However, two items are missing or unclear: (1) The OLG does not mention the requirement to report receipt of substantial lottery or gambling winnings — FNS 726 lists this as a mandatory reporting item for all simplified reporting households, and FNS 720.4 elaborates on it, but the OLG's simplified reporting pages do not reference lottery/gambling winnings at all. (2) The OLG refers generically to the 'gross income limit for the household size' without specifying the threshold — FNS 726 specifies 130% FPL or the BBCE income limit as applicable under state options. The 'What is SNAP?' page references 200% FPL (MA's BBCE threshold), but the simplified reporting pages themselves do not connect to a specific percentage, relying instead on a reference to 'Helpful Charts and Figures.' The lottery/gambling winnings gap is the more significant finding, as workers processing simplified reporting cases would not know from the OLG that this is a mandatory reporting item.
